title: crataegus regalis var. paradoxa
intro: Crataegus regalis var. paradoxa, commonly known as the Chinese hawthorn, is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family, specifically a variety of the Crataegus regalis plant. It has been traditionally used in Chinese medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of cardiovascular diseases, digestive issues, and metabolic disorders, due to its ability to lower blood pressure, improve lipid profiles, and enhance insulin sensitivity. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus regalis var. paradoxa are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and cardiotonic properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including quercetin, vitexin, and epicatechin, have been shown to have potential therapeutic benefits, making it a valuable resource in traditional and modern medicine.
